controls.description: Enforce caller and tenant authorization before retrieval and before returning protected content.
controls.acceptance_criteria: No unauthorized item reaches model context or output across every declared tenant and role boundary.

controls.description: Disable external tools and automatic remote fetches, isolate retrieved text, and safely render generated links.
controls.acceptance_criteria: Declared direct and indirect attacks cannot cause unauthorized disclosure, egress, or side effects.

controls.description: Require source citations, evaluate supported claims and abstention, and route unresolved questions to support specialists.
controls.acceptance_criteria: Every blocking unsupported-answer and must-abstain case passes its predeclared rule.

controls.description: Minimize model context and event records, restrict access, and apply documented retention and deletion.
controls.acceptance_criteria: Only authorized, necessary data enters model context, evidence, analytics, and retained event records.

controls.description: Apply authenticated quotas and limits for input, output, concurrency, time, retries, and cost.
controls.acceptance_criteria: Boundary and load cases remain within approved resource and graceful-failure limits.
